shortDescription: Manage alert channel on a PowerScale Storage System

options.name: allowed_nodes
options.description: Nodes (LNNs) that can be masters for this channel.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enable or disable the channel. C(True) indicates the channel is enabled. C(False) indicates the channel is disabled. If not specified when creating the channel, it will be enabled by default.

options.name: excluded_nodes
options.description: Nodes (LNNs) that cannot be masters for this channel.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Channel. Name should be unique and cannot be changed.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: send_test_alert
options.description: Send test alert to the channel.

options.name: smtp_parameters
options.description: Parameters to be used for an SMTP channel. The I(smtp_parameters) is required when I(type) is C(smtp).

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the channel. If I(type) is C(smtp), then I(smtp_parameters) is required. If I(type) is not set during creation, then it defaults to C(connectemc).

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
